title: Canonical sequence evaluation agrees with literal vertical evaluation
statement: For the actual coefficient ring sequence of l and E on W, coefficientSequenceEvaluation equals tensorReductionLiteralEvaluation, the explicitly typed abbreviation of systemSequenceEvaluation of coefficientSequenceCommRingSystem from [def-coef-ringed-sequence-site] and [lem-pur-system-ringed-sequence-site]. The literal evaluation preserves zero morphisms. Mapping this equality to cochain complexes gives a single shared evaluation isomorphism, used to transport finite chain components without changing any scalar action.

source.place: Tag 0941, the vertical slices of the ringed sequence site; canonical coefficient evaluation and literal system evaluation.

proof.text: Supply exact native-universe smallness, sheafification and locally bijective instances by specializing the existing coefficient-site constructions; this avoids unconstrained maximum universes. First specialize literal evaluation to the native coefficient/module universes using the explicit functor type. Unfold the two pushforward definitions. Both structural ring maps are the identity at every section; the canonical ring equality produces this identity by ObjectProperty.eqToHom_hom and eqToHom_app. Sheaf and natural-transformation extensionality give equality of the maps, hence of the evaluation functors. Literal evaluation preserves zero maps sectionwise. Transport preservation of zero across the equality and apply NatIso.mapHomologicalComplex to obtain the shared complex isomorphism.

proof_origin.place: Identity of the actual vertical coefficient maps; the evaluation part of step 1 of lem-coef-tensor-reduction-ordinary-model
